original_sentence: New research looked at people who increased their exercise levels after their 40s beyond levels they had when they were younger and those individuals showed declines in their risk of early mortality which were similar to those of people who exercised consistently throughout their lives.
translation: 新研究考察了那些 40 多岁以后把运动水平提高到超过年轻时水平的人，结果这些人早亡风险的下降幅度与终身坚持锻炼的人相近。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: throughout their lives 在本句中对应"贯穿一生"。
increase exercise levels 在本句中对应"提高运动水平"。
early mortality 在本句中对应"早亡；过早死亡"。
beyond levels 在本句中对应"超过……水平"。
exercise consistently 在本句中对应"持续稳定地锻炼"。
